about.heading: Real Fire. Real Dera Flavour.
about.imageAlt: Steaming chicken karahi in an iron wok
about.para1: Dera BBQ House began with a single clay tandoor and a charcoal pit in Bahria Town Phase 7. Our kababs are hand-rolled every morning, marinated in family spice blends, and grilled over real charcoal — never gas, never shortcuts.
about.para2: Today our kitchen serves hundreds of families a day, but every order still gets the dera treatment: slow-cooked karahis, smoky seekh kababs and piping-hot naans slapped fresh onto the tandoor wall.
